what: decision 141, the music loops of the app's pack as the app plays them (free, no call that makes sound). seam-<season>: 16 s of the packed loop public/audio/music-<season>.mp3, decoded, played round with the app's cross of one bar (2.4 s, equal power; heardLoop of tools/lib/audio.mjs): the last 7 s of one round, then the first 9 s of the next, so the cross lies from 7.0 to 9.4 s of the clip. plain-<season>: the control, 16 s of the same loop from 2.6 to 18.6 s of one round, with no seam in it. Two listenings of each seam clip, one of each control, the same prompt, which does not say that the music loops or where.
